text.en: Renaming of High School. - The name of San Narciso Vocational High School in the Municipality of San Narciso, Province of Quezon is hereby changed to Godofredo M. Tan Memorial School of Arts and Trades.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
